sn56.45:2.2: “Today, sir, I robed up in the morning and, taking my bowl and robe, entered Vesālī for alms.
sn56.45:2.3: I saw, sir, several Licchavi youths practicing archery near the town hall, shooting arrows from a distance through a small keyhole, shaft after shaft without missing.
sn56.45:2.5: ‘These Licchavi youths really are trained, so well trained,
sn56.45:2.6: in that they shoot arrows from a distance through a small keyhole, shaft after shaft without missing.’”
